items.title: Meta launches Direct, a standalone messaging app for Instagram
items.summary: Direct is launching in Turkey and Thailand, and can be used with or without an Instagram account.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
items.summary: Planning a trip is a favorite demo for personal AI assistants: you can try it with Muse, or with Gemini or half a dozen other choices. But while most pitches use travel-planning as part of a general-purpose agent pitch, a new startup from a Google Maps alum is betting that a specialized travel-planning agent can […]
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: Instagram’s new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos
items.summary: The announcement likely comes in response to creators' concerns over how easily original content can be copied and redistributed across social media platforms, especially considering how generative AI has made it easier to manipulate existing videos.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
items.summary: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 Billion in a Series C funding round.
items.creator: Ram Iyer

items.title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
items.summary: Science Corp raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
items.summary: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec
